description: Increase image resolution and optionally enhance visual quality.

enhanceQuality.description: Whether to enhance image quality during upscaling.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the image to upscale. Width and height must each be at most 4096 pixels.

magnification.description: Upscaling magnification factor from 1 to 4. Decimal values are supported.
